incidents.name: RFB predictable randomness
incidents.notes: RFB derives its reward lottery from on-chain values a contract can read in the same transaction (block data and balances), so the attacker predicted the outcome and only entered when it paid out.

sources.ref: onchain review: RFB 0x26f1457f067bF26881F311833391b52cA871a4b5 created 2022-12-03T15:45:54Z by 0x5c0a527beef80f5e479abb0776e53073aaa2a935, unrelated to attack sender 0x5f7db41e2196080f397cdcf8dd58e8adfdaf2ade; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. lossUsd converts the 12 BNB reported by DeFiHackLabs: 12 BNB x $289.90 at incidentTimestamp 1670260745 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $3,479.
